name: 5tick
description: 5Tick AI coding agent — Trae-like chat + tools for VS Code

fiveTick.agentUrl.description: URL of the local 5Tick agent server

fiveTick.apiBase.description: OpenAI-compatible API base (overrides agent .env). Examples: https://api.openai.com/v1, http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

fiveTick.apiKey.description: API key for the model provider (overrides agent .env). Prefer OS secret storage for production.

fiveTick.model.description: Model id (overrides agent .env). For uncensored local use e.g. llama3.1 / dolphin-mixtral via Ollama.

fiveTick.uncensoredPreset.description: When true and apiBase is empty, default the bundled agent to local Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, model dolphin-mixtral:8x7b) and auto-start Ollama if needed

fiveTick.autoOpenChangedFiles.description: Open files after the agent writes them

fiveTick.showDiffOnWrite.description: Automatically open a before/after diff when a file is written

fiveTick.mirrorTerminal.description: Echo agent shell commands into a VS Code terminal named 5Tick

fiveTick.defaultMode.description: Default agent mode: ask (read-only), ide (assisted), or solo (autonomous)

fiveTick.cloudUrl.description: 5Tick cloud control plane (auth/history/billing). Leave empty to use local agent only.

fiveTick.useCloudAgent.description: When true, route agent runs through fiveTick.cloudUrl instead of fiveTick.agentUrl

fiveTick.authToken.description: Session token from cloud login (filled after OAuth when enabled)

fiveTick.authEnabled.description: Enable cloud login UI when GitHub/Google OAuth credentials are configured on the server

fiveTick.safeMode.description: Ask Allow/Deny before write_file and run_terminal (not content censorship)
